title: The same result written out as the CSV the question actually asks for
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/csv
var subjects = (payload map $.subject) distinctBy $
---
payload groupBy $.student pluck ((rows, student) -> subjects reduce ((subj, acc = { student: student }) -> acc ++ { (subj): (rows filter ($.subject == subj))[0].score default 0 }))

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/csv

explanation.approach: Every row has exactly three fields in the same order, so the CSV writer's header lines up with every row underneath it.
